Even ACK virtio_blk rejects these geometries at device validation, so this does not enable an SDK storage mode. Keep consistent native power-of-two validation and arithmetic. Pinned SDK uses virtio block storage. ACK and native virtio reject non-power-of-two zone sizes and virtio sets neither ORDERED_HWQ nor ZWOR. ACK stacking clears ORDERED_HWQ when the lower device lacks it. Native generic zoned support and Android metadata encryption remain; no arbitrary future controller equivalence or runtime storage verification is claimed.
